decision.explanation: The provided documents contain contradictory assertions regarding the namesake of Gerstnerova street. Document 1 (D1S3) explicitly states the street was named in 2012 in honor of the album "Fallen Empires" by Snow Patrol. Document 2 (D2S2, D2S10) asserts the street was named in the late 19th century (specifically 1885) in honor of the physicist Franz Josef Gerstner. Per the instruction to preserve distinct valid referents and complementary answers where competing assertions exist without resolving them as errors, both answers are retained as they represent the specific claims found in the source texts.
